title: New nVent Customer Experience Center Showcases the Power of an Integrated Solutions Provider
body_markdown:
NEWS ARTICLE


New nVent Customer Experience Center Showcases the Power of an Integrated Solutions Provider


### The new Center offers an immersive look at how nVent solutions support the world's growing demand for electrification.


*By Martha Bennett, Chief Marketing Officer, and Joe Stark, Chief Revenue Officer*


As the world becomes increasingly electrified, nVent customers face a new level of complexity. Whether they are modernizing the grid, building AI-ready data centers, automating manufacturing operations or expanding critical infrastructure, the challenge is no longer finding individual products. It's finding partners who can help provide interconnected solutions across the entire electrical ecosystem.


This November, nVent is taking a significant step forward in helping customers navigate that complexity with the opening of our new Customer Experience Center (CEC), a purpose-built environment designed to bring the power of nVent solutions to life. The more than 10,000-square-foot space showcases more than 300 nVent products and solutions working together across real-world customer applications.


The Customer Experience Center is not a showroom. It is a destination where customers, channel partners, sales representatives and nVent teams can ideate, collaborate, train, solve challenges, and see firsthand how integrated infrastructure solutions can accelerate business outcomes.


**Bringing the Complete nVent Story to Life**


nVent continues to expand its portfolio and capabilities to help customers connect and protect critical electrical infrastructure. Today, customers often engage with individual nVent brands and technologies. Yet many do not realize the breadth of solutions that nVent offers across our many brands and portfolios. The Customer Experience Center was intentionally designed to change that.


Visitors experience a guided journey through the flow of power, following electricity from generation and transmission through distribution to the applications where it powers modern life. Along the way, they see how nVent solutions work together to address some of the most pressing electrical infrastructure challenges facing the world today, including grid resiliency, AI-driven data center growth, industrial automation and increasing demands for electrical reliability.


The experience demonstrates how nVent integrates our capabilities in new ways to create new solutions. Rather than presenting products in isolation, the center connects technologies, expertise and solutions into a cohesive story focused on customer outcomes.


**Fostering Deeper Customer Engagements**


Today's electrical infrastructure challenges require more than transactional discussions.


Utility operators are working to strengthen aging grids while expanding capacity. Data center developers are racing to support unprecedented demand for AI computing. Industrial organizations are seeking greater reliability, efficiency and resilience across increasingly electrified operations.


These conversations are often complex, involving multiple stakeholders, technical requirements and business priorities.


The Customer Experience Center creates an environment where those conversations can be supported with hands-on demonstration and exploration of nVent solutions. Customers can engage directly with nVent experts, explore applications in realistic environments and gain a deeper understanding of how integrated solutions can help solve their specific challenges.


By allowing visitors to see, touch and interact with solutions in context, the center helps bridge the gap between product specifications and in use applications.


**Accelerating Decisions Through Shared Understanding**


The Customer Experience Center supports a wide range of engagements, from executive briefings and strategic planning sessions to application-focused discussions and technical training. Dedicated meeting and collaboration spaces complement immersive solution displays, enabling visitors to move seamlessly between discussion and demonstration. This combination of collaboration and experience helps transform nVent meetings into working sessions focused on solving real-world challenges.


**Inspiring Collaboration Across the Value Chain**


Many of the most important infrastructure challenges require close collaboration among manufacturers, contractors, channel partners, engineering firms, integrators and end users. The Customer Experience Center was designed to support those connections.


By bringing diverse stakeholders together in a shared environment, the center creates opportunities for new ideas, deeper partnerships and faster problem-solving. Visitors can explore industry trends, discuss emerging technologies and collaborate on solutions that address evolving customer needs.


The result is a stronger ecosystem built around a common goal: enabling a more connected and electrified world.


**Supporting the Future of Electrification**


The themes highlighted throughout the Customer Experience Center all point to a single reality: electrification is an infrastructure story. Every new data center, grid modernization project, manufacturing facility upgrade and critical infrastructure investment depends on reliable electrical systems working together seamlessly.


At nVent, we are inventing the electrified future. The new Customer Experience Center demonstrates how we are helping make that future possible by connecting and protecting the infrastructure that powers modern life.


We look forward to welcoming customers and partners beginning in November 2026.
